Use case: stylized-concept. Original production sprite sheet for Echoes of Dante, Organic Sci-Fi R3. Input image is ONLY the costume/identity reference of this project's current Warrior; redesign its proportions and rendering quality while keeping functional pale ivory/sage field armor, charcoal technical fabric, small orange diagonal chest harness and cyan physical helmet visor. NO copied game characters.
Create a transparent 4-column by 2-row sprite sheet, exactly EIGHT separate full-height human character BODY+LEGS poses, all facing toward camera (downscreen), seen from elevated oblique action-RPG camera approximately 35 degrees above horizontal. NO arms or hands, NO weapon: arm parts will be attached in engine. Keep small shoulder armor caps but exposed empty space immediately below each cap; no arm stumps outside body. Both entire legs and boots MUST be drawn as part of each pose. Helmet, human neck, torso, hips, articulated knees, ankle and practical boots. Anatomically convincing adult explorer proportions, head approximately one-sixth body height, not toy/chibi/astronaut bobble-head, no massive shoulder blocks. Restrained broad painted volumes, recessed joints, manufactured ceramic armor and woven cloth, soft upper-left light and own shadows, warm worn edges, clear silhouette at 100px tall. Clearly richer and more human than the input icon.
Equal-sized grid cells, one character centered in each, full figure with transparent margins, all feet on same baseline, same costume, lighting, camera, scale and body height across frames. No frames touch each other.
Top row left to right: (0) ready standing relaxed knees, (1) walking left leg forward bent right knee behind, (2) walking passing pose, one foot planted and other heel lifting, (3) walking right leg forward bent left knee behind.
Bottom row left to right: (4) attack preparation weight back with torso wound up, (5) attack lunge planted front boot bent knee and twisting torso, (6) charging skill firmly planted wide stance knees bent and torso braced, (7) dash launch low athletic forward lean with trailing extended leg.
These must be genuinely DIFFERENT DRAWN POSES, with visible hip/knee/boot articulation, not eight copies of standing body. Boots remain the bottom of each character. Camera never changes, head always above torso. NO text, no labels, no grids, no border, no background, NO floor, NO cast shadow. TRUE transparent alpha. No fantasy medieval knight, no spaceship, no rock armor, no large triangular facets. Human functional technology worn by a living explorer.
